known_holdout_manifests.note: the checkpoint's own held-out registry test set (lateral-registry probe grid); distinct from, and not to be confused with, the EPC evaluation structures below

known_training_manifests.note: the actual dataset run_tbg_registry_spectral_loss.py:split_paths() reads (DATASET = Comparison/datasets/tbg_md_plus_registry/n558); its train split has exactly 558 rows, matching training_plan.json:physical_train_samples=558 exactly (row-for-row: split_paths() computes physical_train_samples as len(train_paths) over this same manifest's train split). 474 of the 558 rows are MD-sourced (sample_id prefixed by their source MD stacking, not 'tbg_registry_grid_12x12__'); registry_mask in split_paths() identifies the other 84 as registry rows by the 'tbg_registry_grid_12x12__' sample_id prefix -- the same 84 rows already declared in the entry below via tbg_registry_grid_12x12/frozen_split_manifest.json, now doubly covered. Each MD row carries source_run/source_sample_id back to Comparison/datasets/tbg_pure_md_nested/n474 (itself traceable to Comparison/datasets/bilayer_graphene_{AA,AB,BA}_md200, which still holds raw MD_steps/md_temperature_blocks on disk) plus a full artifact_sha256 block (RUN.fdf, XV, HSX, TSHS, TSDE, ORB_INDX, STRUCT_OUT, metadata) per row.

matches training_plan.json:registry_samples=84; kept alongside the n558 manifest above as the original, narrower reference (the 84 rows it declares are a strict subset of the n558 manifest's 558 train rows)

checkpoint_lineage.structural_family_note: The checkpoint's known training/holdout data is lateral-registry-probe bilayer graphene (commensurate AA/AB/BA stacking grids, small unit cells) plus an MD component (bilayer graphene AA/AB/BA stacking, ~200-step trajectories at multiple temperature blocks; see Comparison/datasets/tbg_pure_md_nested/n474 and its source bilayer_graphene_{AA,AB,BA}_md200 datasets). The EPC evaluation structures are a pristine graphene primitive cell (2 atoms) and a rigid (31,30) magic-angle twisted-bilayer supercell (11164 atoms) -- a different structural family by atom count and stacking construction alone. audit_epc_lineage.py verifies this claim by geometry comparison rather than accepting this note as sufficient.
checkpoint_lineage.training_provenance_gap: Previously: training_plan.json declares physical_train_samples=558 drawn from MD trajectories, and no row-level manifest for that MD-sourced portion had been located. Resolved 2026-09-04: Comparison/datasets/tbg_md_plus_registry/n558/frozen_split_manifest.json is the exact dataset run_tbg_registry_spectral_loss.py:split_paths() reads to build train_paths (DATASET points at this directory); its train split has exactly 558 rows (474 MD-sourced + 84 registry-sourced, matching physical_train_samples=558/registry_samples=84 precisely), each with structure paths, artifact sha256 hashes and source_run/source_sample_id lineage back to the raw MD trajectory datasets, which are still present on disk. See known_training_manifests above.

upstream_checkpoint.relationship: spectral-best checkpoint is fine-tuned from this base checkpoint (training_plan.json:source_checkpoint); its own training lineage is not re-traced by this document and is declared unknown to audit_epc_lineage.py

frozen_before_commit.note: This document was authored at working-tree state descending from this commit. It consolidates protocol files that were themselves frozen (see each source_protocols[].sha256 and generated_at) at or before this commit, and it records the checkpoint/structure sha256 values it read at authoring time. Any later change to a referenced checkpoint, manifest or structure file will change its sha256 and audit_epc_lineage.py will report the reference as stale rather than silently re-trusting it.

claim_declared.type: OOD_by_structural_family (graphene primitive cell vs. bilayer-stacking training/holdout families) evaluated as interpolation within the fixed PROD-SZ basis

prospective_qualification_v2.cohort: 400 k points from the certified graphene TSHS grid already used by the GO-2 and reference_basis_convergence gates; no new sampling is required for the derivative-level claim.
prospective_qualification_v2.deltas_and_convergence: 5-point FD/Richardson stencil in PROD-SZ; see delta_plateau_topology_certification and reference_basis_convergence gate artifacts under Comparison/results/epc/.
prospective_qualification_v2.final_state_reason: route_evaluation blocks opening a valid confirmatory final_test under this document: the executable route is ineligible and the eligible route was not started. This does not change GO-4, delta_out_closure or any already-produced gate artifact; it only records why no new confirmatory label may be generated for the covariant PAO matrix derivative claim yet.
prospective_qualification_v2.lineage_component_grouping: Reuses check_geometry_leakage.py (already shared by audit_epc_lineage.py, the graph2mat/DeepH benchmark gate, and Comparison/scripts/ops/audit_geometry_independence.py) for exact/near-duplicate and rotation/translation-invariant geometry comparison. No new grouping/cache/campaign infrastructure was added for this document.
prospective_qualification_v2.primary_metric: delta_g = C_f^dagger (Delta_G2M - Delta_SIESTA) C_i per electronic block, normalized by the preregistered tau_model reference scale -- never a global Frobenius norm converted to a percent of g (see docs/epc_go4_graphene_gamma_verdict.md section 4).
prospective_qualification_v2.purpose: Prospective declaration required by the E-F_001 covariant-PAO-response task before any confirmatory label is generated or opened. Registers the claim scope, the sealing gap, and why the only currently-executable route cannot open a validly blinded final_test -- rather than silently reusing the historical (contaminated) selection as if it were fresh.

clean_reselection.reason: Requires training from scratch with train/selection_validation/threshold_calibration/final_test splits separated by lineage. Out of scope for this document: no retraining, no orchestrator attempt, and no reordering of the 12 surviving snapshots was performed or authorized here.

route_evaluation.consequence: No route currently supports a validly blinded prospective confirmatory claim for the graphene-Gamma checkpoint response. The only executable route (legacy_fixed_candidate) is ineligible on its own stated precondition; clean_reselection is eligible but not started.

legacy_fixed_candidate.reason: The legacy route requires a holdout 'nunca fue usado en entrenamiento, seleccion, calibracion o inspeccion'. This precondition is already checked by existing, already-running infrastructure: certify_checkpoint_lineage_and_exclusion.py marks both EPC evaluation structures previously_inspected=true and blind_holdout=false in Comparison/results/epc/checkpoint_lineage_exclusion/checkpoint_lineage_exclusion.json (PREVIOUSLY_INSPECTED registry: graphene_primitive_cell_equilibrium opened repeatedly by certify_basis_response.py, run_epc_convergence_sweeps.py and quantify_checkpoint_derivative_error.py while tolerances were being set; matbg_rigid_31_30_magic_angle opened by benchmark_matbg_synthetic_displacements.py and certify_matbg_phonon_provider.py). Inspection already happened, so the no-prior-inspection precondition fails regardless of geometry-leakage status, and the script's own blind_holdout_reason already states this cannot be relabelled a blind holdout.

sealing.note: A locally-created commit hash does not demonstrate blinding: no signed remote commit, independent timestamp authority or third-party escrow exists in this repository for this artifact. Per policy this keeps blinding_status=prospective_unblinded and confirmatory results NO_GO regardless of any individual gate's numeric outcome.

secondary_metrics: singular values of D_QH per k-point
worst electronic block (measured worst r=2.41 against tau_model=2.84, docs/epc_go4_graphene_gamma_verdict.md)
prospective_qualification_v2.single_opening_policy: evaluate_epc_metrics.py rejects a protocol whose hash does not reproduce frozen_content_sha256 and does not re-adjudicate a candidate against the same cohort after a failure (docs/epc_go4_graphene_gamma_verdict.md section 7); this document adds no second adjudicator.

purpose: The scientific audit of E-F_001 found preregistration/holdout controls scattered across per-protocol JSON files with no single frozen declaration of the holdout set and no checkpoint-lineage record at all. This document consolidates the holdout declarations already frozen in Comparison/results/epc/preregistration/**/*.json (by reference and sha256, not by copying their content) and adds the checkpoint-lineage declaration those files were missing. It is the --preregistration input audit_epc_lineage.py reads.
relationship_to_v1: Adds the prospective_qualification_v2 block required before opening any confirmatory label for E-F_001's validated_covariant_PAO_matrix_derivative claim. Does not rewrite, delete or re-hash any v1 source_protocols/checkpoint_lineage entry: those remain the frozen historical input already read by already-produced artifacts (e.g. Comparison/results/epc/gamma_epc/graphene/go4_verdict.json). docs/epc_preregistration_v1.json is kept unmodified on disk as that historical record.
